name: Asymmetric Mathematical Formulation of Symmetric Constraints
description: I replaced the symmetric "cannot share" constraint with the mathematically equivalent but syntactically asymmetric condition "A_u + 2*A_v is not a multiple of 3". Models that rely on surface translation will likely try to evaluate this asymmetrically inside a standard undirected graph backtracking template, losing the original (u, v) order and failing. Models that genuinely reason will deduce it is equivalent to A_u != A_v and safely treat it as an undirected graph.
